fixes.what: No ledger event explains the change from the north-only polity of 1792-1793 (keyframe haiti_1792 adjusted to Nord, Nord-Est and Nord-Ouest) to the whole-colony outline of the author's new keyframe haiti_1794 (1794-1799), roughly a threefold area change; /ledger/1-4 are only contest events with Britain.
fixes.why: Haitian Revolution page: 'Louverture abandoned the Spanish Army in the east and brought his forces over to the French side on 6 May 1794' and 'Having made himself master of the island, however, Toussaint did not wish to surrender too much power to France'. The author's own keyframe note quotes the 6 May 1794 switch, so this is not a page-budget gap.
fixes.fix: Add a 1794 (month 5) event, gain (or merge) with counterpart french-first-republic, confidence 2, source the Haitian Revolution page, region the colony outside the three northern departements and outside the British-held Jeremie, Mole and Port-au-Prince zones, note quoting the 6 May 1794 switch. Alternatively keep the north-only outline until the year the page shows Toussaint master of the colony and move haiti_1794's 'from' to that year with the matching gain.

fixes.what: The 1800 gain of Rigaud's south (Jacmel, 60 km) is land the keyframe haiti_1794 (1794-1799) already draws as this state's, so ledger and keyframe disagree.
fixes.why: Haitian Revolution page: 'In June 1799, Rigaud initiated the War of the South against Toussaint's rule' and 'On 11 March 1800, Toussaint took Jacmel and Rigaud fled'; the dossier's own note says the south had been Rigaud's since 1794.
fixes.fix: Either take Rigaud's southern department (Sud, Grand'Anse, Nippes, Sud-Est) out of haiti_1794 for 1794-1799 (at least 1799) and give /ledger/5 that whole department as its region, or replace /ledger/5 by a contest_start 1799 / contest_end 1800 over the south.
